raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Streaming requests with literal stop strings decode the same output tail during finish checking and stream-prefix checking. The prefix check also compares every possible prefix length even when the final character rules out all partial matches. This adds per-token CPU work on small-model, high-concurrency streaming workloads.

## Modifications

The optimization is opt-in and disabled by default. Set `SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION=1` before starting the server to enable it. The setting is resolved once at import; the disabled path performs no memoization or prefix membership pruning, though a cached-boolean branch remains.

```bash
SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION=1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path MODEL_PATH
```

`MODEL_PATH` is an existing supported Hugging Face model ID or local model directory; use your usual platform and parallelism arguments. Leave the variable unset (or set it to `0`) for the default path. Changing it requires restarting the service.

- Reuse the decoded tail for streaming literal-stop requests. The cache includes the complete tail token sequence and window/output lengths, and verifies tokenizer identity, so same-length output rewrites and tokenizer changes invalidate it.
- Keep nonstreaming and stop-regex requests on the uncached path. Regex windows can cover the entire output, so this change does not keep a second full-output token tuple for them.
- After preserving the full-substring check, skip partial-prefix comparisons if the tail's last character does not occur in the stop string. A nonempty matching suffix must end in a character from that stop string.

Tail-window selection, decoding semantics, finish-state transitions, and trimming are unchanged. This is a CPU optimization; it does not add GPU matching, synchronization, or token tables. Prior tail-cache attempts: #35246 and #41115. This version limits reuse to the streaming literal-stop path and combines it with a necessary-condition prefix guard.

## Accuracy Tests

The submitted head is `6ca3e0d8926e0bef0c87fe0df46211f461dc33fe`. Its 26 focused stop/cache/speculative unit tests passed again in a separate compatible environment. The tests cover cache invalidation, same-length rewrites, tokenizer/window changes, Unicode, overlapping prefixes, regex bypass, and primed-cache speculative acceptance.

The exact four-file PR delta was also applied without conflicts to pinned official main `585bfe32a724bde0fd65a04245561eb72614da35` in an isolated integration checkout. Independent inspection confirmed the two optimized methods match this PR's AST and that the newer incremental detokenizer remains unchanged. All 25 corresponding unit tests passed there; main had removed the old decoded-text fallback and its test.

Full integration service validation uses the checkout itself, without method injection or bypassed dependency checks: Python 3.12.16, Torch 2.14.1 / CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.19.0, tokenizers 0.23.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10 and FlashInfer 0.7.2. One RTX 5090 runs TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, FP16, Triton attention, greedy decoding, CUDA Graph, and one request at a time. Independent server processes validate the flag unset/default-off and `SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION=1`.

- 20 real requests cover no stop, hit, nonhit, overlapping stops and cross-token stops, in streaming and nonstreaming modes. Both modes pass. An independent tokenizer-prefix oracle confirms exact text trimming, earliest accepted stop token, returned token IDs, completion count and finish reason. Every SSE event preserves the expected prefix and leaks no complete stop string; off/on responses agree.
- Eight additional real requests use legal `logit_bias` to produce a controlled Unicode sequence (`é` tokens), then stop on `éé` across two tokens. Default-off and opt-in streaming/nonstreaming runs all pass: exactly two accepted output tokens, empty trimmed text, correct completion count/finish reason, and no stop leakage in any SSE event. This is a controlled Unicode boundary test, not a multilingual model-quality claim.
- Source and model identities are recorded, and source hashes remained unchanged. Independent review of the raw responses found no blocking defect in this scope. The 20-request service matrix peaked at 11,994 MiB, stayed within its time/request budget, and released its GPU processes.

This is bounded functional integration evidence, not current-main throughput data or coverage of every model, tokenizer, backend, concurrency level, regex/speculative server configuration or custom stateful decoder. Unicode/regex/speculative component cases are also covered by the focused CPU tests. The default remains off.

The GitHub Lint workflow passed on this head. Earlier red checks were inspected using original job logs: 11 Draft gates, six dependent-status aggregators, and two superseded title-format failures; the corrected title check passes. Gated/skipped jobs are not counted as functional passes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The following are **prototype results on installed SGLang 0.5.20**, not throughput measurements of this exact current-main patch. The prototype implements the same literal-stop idea via project-local hooks; this patch additionally bypasses tail caching for all regex requests and uses an opt-in startup flag. Each table entry is the five-round median from one independent service pair. Positive cases were repeated with reversed service order.

| Model | Baseline output tokens/s | Prototype output tokens/s | Change | Independent reverse-order confirmation |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Qwen3-0.6B | 25,932 | 29,227 | +12.71% | +11.95% |
| TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 | 23,469 | 27,820 | +18.54% | +18.87% |
| SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct | 20,873 | 20,822 | -0.24% | Not repeated; no observed benefit |
| Qwen3-4B | 12,533 | 12,534 | +0.01% | Not repeated; no observed benefit |

The two larger-model cases are neutral in this workload. Nonstreaming controls are approximately tied overall; the SmolLM2 single-pair median was -1.39% (pooled -0.86%), with overlapping rounds. This is not a universal speedup claim.

Full service correctness on the pinned official-main integration is now documented above. The throughput results below remain measurements of the installed 0.5.20 host/prototype; they are not relabeled as current-main throughput.

Additional validation of the **exact two PR methods inside the installed 0.5.20 host service** is complete. The unchanged `tail_str` and `check_match_stop_str_prefix` AST from this commit was compiled into the host Req class for both arms, with its startup boolean disabled/enabled. Source snapshots, method AST hashes, and the installed host hash were checked. This isolates the submitted methods; it is **not** full current-main service or full environment-variable integration validation.

| TinyLlama, exact PR methods in 0.5.20 host | Flag off, token/s | Flag on, token/s | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Streaming | 23,417 | 28,802 | +23.00% |
| Nonstreaming | 30,379 | 30,384 | +0.02% |

One independent service pair, five measured rounds per condition after three warmups. Streaming round ranges were 23,367-23,559 off versus 28,717-29,083 on. Nonstreaming pooled throughput changed -0.12%, so that control is reported as tied. A separate strict real-service gate passed 24 actual-stop comparisons plus one nonhit probe; text, output IDs, completion count and finish reason matched. The one-time instrumentation wrapper was removed during warmup before formal measurement. Performance output hash sets remain a limitation; this is not a bitwise-paired performance claim.

Prototype conditions: one RTX 5090, overlap and model CUDA Graph enabled, BF16, 128 concurrent independent HTTP /generate requests, 1024 requests/round, 128 output tokens/request, four short literal stops, stream_interval=1, identical prompt per model, greedy decoding with ignore_eos. Three warmup rounds excluded; five measured rounds reported by median output tokens/s. Startup is excluded; HTTP/SSE/client scheduling and parsing are included. Radix cache was disabled for both arms. The performance workload does not hit a stop; stop-hit correctness is checked separately.

These are short finite-cohort HTTP tests, not long-running production saturation. Nonstreaming results and compute-heavier models are reported as controls. Performance-output hash sets are not identical across service processes, so the performance runs are not claimed to be bitwise paired; the strict functional gates are separate.

## Checklist

- [x] Repository Lint CI passed on the submitted head.
- [x] Add focused CPU unit tests.
- [x] Independent source review and raw-response validation for the declared scope.
- [x] Complete bounded full-service integration of the exact PR delta on pinned official main with a compatible dependency stack.
- [x] Provide scoped prototype accuracy/performance evidence; keep current-main validation limitations explicit.

Bounded integration validation is complete for the scope described above. Ready for review after the author confirmed internal testing passed for this submitted commit. The optimization remains opt-in and disabled by default. Broader CI and maintainer review remain required before merge.

files.patch: @@ -406,6 +406,11 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Defer the MoE finalize step to overlap it with other work. true + + SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION + Opt in to CPU tail-decode reuse for streaming literal stops and exact stop-prefix pruning. Nonstreaming and stop-regex requests bypass the tail cache. Set before server startup; benchmark with your workload. + false + SGLANG_PATCH_TOKENIZER Patch the tokenizer to cache all_special_tokens/all_special_ids (notably for Kimi tiktoken, where ITL can otherwise regress under high batch size).

@@ -1768,6 +1768,8 @@ class Envs:
     # Think tokens budget: negative means unlimited, >= 0 caps thinking tokens
     SGLANG_MAX_THINK_TOKENS = EnvInt(-1)
     SGLANG_PATCH_TOKENIZER = EnvBool(True)
+    # Opt-in CPU tail reuse and exact prefix pruning for streaming literal stops.
+    SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION = EnvBool(False)
     # Group replies by tokenizer worker; disable for per-request delivery.
     SGLANG_BATCH_TOKENIZER_OUTPUTS = EnvBool(True)
     # Encode long rendered chat prompts as chunks on the tokenizers thread pool.

@@ -178,6 +178,8 @@
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 _is_hip = is_hip()
+# Resolve once at import; do not read the environment on the per-token path.
+_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION = envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.get()
 
 
 ReturnHiddenStatesMode = Union[bool, Literal["last"]]
@@ -1905,7 +1907,24 @@ def tail_str(self, new_accepted_len: int = 1) -> str:
             return ""
 
         tail_len = self._stop_match_tail_len(new_accepted_len)
-        return self.tokenizer.decode(self.output_ids[-tail_len:])
+        tail_ids = self.output_ids[-tail_len:]
+        # Only streaming literal stops reuse this decode in the prefix check.
+        # Regex windows can cover the whole output; do not retain a copy of them.
+        if (
+            not _ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION
+            or self.stream is not True
+            or self.sampling_params.stop_regex_strs
+        ):
+            return self.tokenizer.decode(tail_ids)
+
+        key = (tail_len, len(self.output_ids), tuple(tail_ids))
+        cached = getattr(self, "_stop_tail_cache", None)
+        if cached is not None and cached[0] == key and cached[1] is self.tokenizer:
+            return cached[2]
+
+        tail_str = self.tokenizer.decode(tail_ids)
+        self._stop_tail_cache = (key, self.tokenizer, tail_str)
+        return tail_str
 
     def check_match_stop_str_prefix(self) -> bool:
         if not self.sampling_params.stop_strs:
@@ -1924,6 +1943,10 @@ def check_match_stop_str_prefix(self) -> bool:
             if stop_str in tail_str:
                 return True
 
+            # A matching nonempty suffix must end in a character from stop_str.
+            if _ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION and tail_str[-1] not in stop_str:
+                continue
+
             # Check if tail_str suffix matches stop_str prefix
             # Only check if stop_str is not empty, it's for stream output
             min_len = min(len(tail_str), len(stop_str))

@@ -0,0 +1,239 @@
+"""CPU regressions for streaming stop-prefix checks and tail decode reuse."""
+
+import random
+import unittest
+from array import array
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.managers import schedule_batch
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _CountingTokenizer:
+    eos_token_id = -1
+    additional_stop_token_ids = None
+
+    def __init__(self, replacements=None):
+        self.calls = 0
+        self.replacements = replacements or {}
+
+    def encode(self, text, add_special_tokens=False):
+        return list(map(ord, text))
+
+    def decode(self, ids):
+        self.calls += 1
+        return "".join(self.replacements.get(int(i), chr(int(i))) for i in ids)
+
+
+def _make_req(text, *, stops=("XY",), stream=True, regex=None):
+    tokenizer = _CountingTokenizer()
+    params = SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=1000, stop=list(stops), stop_regex=regex)
+    params.normalize(tokenizer=tokenizer)
+    req = Req(
+        rid="stop-prefix-test",
+        origin_input_text="",
+        origin_input_ids=array("q", [0]),
+        sampling_params=params,
+        eos_token_ids=set(),
+        vocab_size=0x110000,
+        stream=stream,
+    )
+    req.tokenizer = tokenizer
+    req.output_ids = array("q", map(ord, text))
+    return req
+
+
+class TestStopStringPrefixCache(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        enabled = patch.object(schedule_batch, "_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION", True)
+        enabled.start()
+        self.addCleanup(enabled.stop)
+
+    def test_streaming_finish_and_prefix_share_decode(self):
+        req = _make_req("ordinary.")
+        self.assertFalse(req._check_str_based_finish())
+        self.assertFalse(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 1)
+
+    def test_nonstream_does_not_cache(self):
+        req = _make_req("ordinary.", stream=False)
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "ry.")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "ry.")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 2)
+        self.assertFalse(hasattr(req, "_stop_tail_cache"))
+
+    def test_regex_does_not_cache_whole_output(self):
+        req = _make_req("ordinary.", regex=["x.*Y"])
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "ordinary.")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "ordinary.")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 2)
+        self.assertFalse(hasattr(req, "_stop_tail_cache"))
+
+    def test_no_stops_does_not_decode(self):
+        req = _make_req("ordinary.", stops=())
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "")
+        self.assertFalse(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 0)
+
+    def test_empty_output(self):
+        req = _make_req("")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "")
+        self.assertFalse(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+
+    def test_changed_content_with_same_length_and_last_id(self):
+        req = _make_req("abc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "abc")
+        req.output_ids[0] = ord("z")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "zbc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 2)
+
+    def test_append_retract_and_regrow(self):
+        req = _make_req("abc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "abc")
+        req.output_ids.append(ord("d"))
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "bcd")
+        del req.output_ids[-2:]
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "ab")
+        req.output_ids.extend(map(ord, "ed"))
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "bed")
+
+    def test_changed_tokenizer(self):
+        req = _make_req("abc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "abc")
+        req.tokenizer = _CountingTokenizer({ord("a"): "z"})
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "zbc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 1)
+
+    def test_changed_window_and_multi_token_accept(self):
+        req = _make_req("abcdef")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "def")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(new_accepted_len=4), "abcdef")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "def")
+        req.sampling_params.stop_str_max_len = 4
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "bcdef")
+
+    def test_stream_toggle_preserves_values(self):
+        req = _make_req("abc")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "abc")
+        req.stream = False
+        req.output_ids[0] = ord("z")
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "zbc")
+        req.stream = True
+        self.assertEqual(req.tail_str(), "zbc")
+
+    def test_full_matches_precede_last_character_guard(self):
+        # The last character is absent from the stop, but a complete match
+        # earlier in the decoded tail must still hold the stream.
+        for text, stops in [
+            ("before<STOP>after.", ["<STOP>"]),
+            ("beforeé💥after.", ["é💥"]),
+        ]:
+            with self.subTest(text=text):
+                req = _make_req(text, stops=stops)
+                req.sampling_params.stop_str_max_len = len(text)
+                self.assertTrue(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+
+    def test_partial_unicode_overlapping_and_empty_stops(self):
+        for text, stops, expected in [
+            ("hello X", ["XY"], True),
+            ("hello .", ["XY"], False),
+            ("hello你", ["你好"], True),
+            ("hello💥a", ["💥abc"], True),
+            ("e\u0301", ["\u0301x"], True),
+            ("a\n", ["\n\n"], True),
+            ("ababa", ["aba", "ab"], True),
+            ("abc", [""], False),
+            ("", ["XY"], False),
+        ]:
+            with self.subTest(text=text, stops=stops):
+                req = _make_req(text, stops=stops)
+                req.sampling_params.stop_str_max_len = len(text)
+                self.assertEqual(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix(), expected)
+
+    def test_random_unicode_matches_prefix_definition(self):
+        rng = random.Random(28)
+        alphabet = "abé💥\u0301<>_\n。"
+        req = _make_req("")
+        for _ in range(2000):
+            text = "".join(rng.choices(alphabet, k=rng.randrange(30)))
+            stops = [
+                "".join(rng.choices(alphabet, k=rng.randrange(10)))
+                for _ in range(rng.randrange(5))
+            ]
+            req.output_ids = array("q", map(ord, text))
+            req.sampling_params.stop_strs = stops
+            req.sampling_params.stop_str_max_len = len(text)
+            expected = (
+                any(
+                    stop in text
+                    or any(text.endswith(stop[:n]) for n in range(1, len(stop) + 1))
+                    for stop in stops
+                    if stop
+                )
+                if text
+                else False
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix(), expected)
+
+
+class TestStopStringOptimizationOptIn(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_environment_flag_defaults_off(self):
+        self.assertFalse(envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.default)
+        with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.override(True):
+            self.assertTrue(envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.get())
+        with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.override(False):
+            self.assertFalse(envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION.get())
+
+    def test_streaming_speculative_finish_after_primed_tail(self):
+        for enabled in (False, True):
+            for old_text, accepted_text, stop, expected_text in [
+                ("abc", "STOPlater.", "STOP", "abcSTOP"),
+                ("abcX", "Ylater.", "XY", "abcXY"),
+            ]:
+                with (
+                    self.subTest(enabled=enabled, stop=stop),
+                    patch.object(
+                        schedule_batch, "_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION", enabled
+                    ),
+                ):
+                    req = _make_req(old_text, stops=[stop], stream=True)
+                    req.update_finish_state()
+                    self.assertFalse(req.finished())
+                    req.output_ids.extend(map(ord, accepted_text))
+                    committed_ids = array("q", req.output_ids)
+
+                    # Prime the one-token tail after accepting a chunk. Its stop
+                    # is already outside this window; finishing must widen it.
+                    self.assertNotIn(stop, req.tail_str())
+                    self.assertFalse(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+                    req.update_finish_state(new_accepted_len=len(accepted_text))
+
+                    self.assertTrue(req.finished())
+                    self.assertEqual(req.finished_reason.matched, stop)
+                    self.assertEqual(req.finished_len, len(expected_text))
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        req.output_ids_through_stop, array("q", map(ord, expected_text))
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(req.output_ids, committed_ids)
+
+    def test_disabled_path_does_not_cache_or_prune(self):
+        class StopWithoutMembershipCheck(str):
+            def __contains__(self, value):
+                raise AssertionError("Disabled path must not use the prefix guard")
+
+        with patch.object(schedule_batch, "_ENABLE_STOP_STR_OPTIMIZATION", False):
+            req = _make_req("ordinary.")
+            req.sampling_params.stop_strs = [StopWithoutMembershipCheck("XY")]
+            self.assertFalse(req._check_str_based_finish())
+            self.assertFalse(req.check_match_stop_str_prefix())
+            self.assertEqual(req.tokenizer.calls, 2)
+            self.assertFalse(hasattr(req, "_stop_tail_cache"))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
